subject: R starts in system root dir instead of vim working dir

messages.author: 34aae2227f44592b
messages.subject: R starts in system root dir instead of vim working dir
parts:
Hi,

Since a short while, R started from vim or neovim starts in the root directory of my Linux system instead of the working directory of vim. An upgrade to the latest NVim-R did not help. I also put "let R_nvim_wd = 1" in my .vimrc but this made no difference.

How can I make R start in the working directory of vim?

Many thanks,

Daan

messages.author: 34aae2227f44592b
messages.subject: Re: R starts in system root dir instead of vim working dir
parts: Today I noticed the problem has disappeared (after a reboot due to a system crash). Now R's working dir is the same as Neovim's.
